viewing_check: Estimate A$20-40, current bid A$15. Not a books lot, so skip it unless you want the marbles or dolls. If passing: (1) Pigs Is Pigs, open the title page. You want 'McClure, Phillips & Co.' with MCMVI and 'Published, May, 1906' on the copyright page. Doubleday or no date means a reprint, so walk away. (2) Kookaburra-cover book, read its title, publisher and date; only worth noting if it is pre-1950 Australian. (3) Look under the Footrot Flats stack for any real comics (Australian 1950s Phantom or Frew, Marvel/DC); none are visible in the photos despite the description. (4) Tip out the marbles jar for handmade swirls or onionskins (pontil marks). (5) Check the dolls' necks and backs for maker marks.
